name: gatehouse
description: The Gatehouse (gatehouse, gatehouse_2), rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/gatehouse.md, REBUILD.md), the gate of the stone wall kit (../stone_wall, ../wall_tower). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Until the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes candidates; 'check' asserts the brief's pinned cells on them.

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py gatehouse gatehouse --candidate --nbt out/gatehouse.nbt && LEVEL=2 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py gatehouse gatehouse_2 --candidate --nbt out/gatehouse-2.nbt && python3 selfcheck.py
